DISASTIG.title: Oracle Linux 9 Security Technical Implementation Guide

Rule.title: SRG-OS-000480-GPOS-00227
Rule.Description: Fixture: an ordinary rule, so this STIG does not convert to nothing at all - the point being pinned is that the three Permission rules below convert to nothing, not that the whole role is empty.
Rule.RawString: Verify that OL 9 uses a file integrity tool configured with FIPS 140-3-approved cryptographic hashes.

Rule.title: SRG-OS-000392-GPOS-00172
Rule.Description: Fixture: ContainsLine's word-separators are U+00A0, not an ordinary space - the only hit across all in-scope nxFileLine rules' ContainsLine fields. See #90.
Rule.RawString: Verify that OL 9 generates audit records for all account creations, modifications, disabling, and termination events that affect /var/log/tallylog.

Rule.title: SRG-OS-000480-GPOS-00227
Rule.Description: Fixture: an unparsed Permission rule with no AccessControlEntry - converts to nothing, since there is no Linux Permission generator and the Windows one's own foreach over AccessControlEntry.Entry yields zero tasks regardless.
Rule.RawString: Verify that OL 9 configures permissions of the "/etc/ssh/sshd_config" file.

Rule.title: SRG-OS-000480-GPOS-00227
Rule.Description: Fixture: a second unparsed Permission rule, marked a duplicate of V-271778.
Rule.RawString: Verify that OL 9 configures permissions of the cron directories.

Rule.title: SRG-OS-000480-GPOS-00227
Rule.Description: Fixture: a third unparsed Permission rule, also marked a duplicate of V-271778.
Rule.RawString: Verify that OL 9 configures permissions of /etc/crontab.
